summary: PLATE 0.8.1 -- adopter time-to-value routing, namespaced docs on import, host-native prompts, and a .plate platform setting for POSIX and Windows scripts.

entries.migration_impact: When importing PLATE into a repo that already has non-PLATE files under docs/, all PLATE documentation (design/, wiki/, research/, audits/, migration/, bootstrap/, marketing/, adr/, and root docs files) will install under docs/plate/ instead of the docs root. References in AGENTS.md, workflows, issue templates, and payload docs themselves are rewritten automatically. Root files docs/README.md and docs/playwright-e2e-guide.md count as PLATE only when their content matches the template markers, so a product README at that path triggers namespacing and is not overwritten. Explicit --namespace-docs / --no-namespace-docs (CLI) and namespace_docs (MCP plate_import_payload; omit to auto-detect) are wired through. The migration guide ships in the template payload at docs/migration/namespace-docs-migration.md.
entries.agent_notes: When importing PLATE payload, use auto-detect (namespace_docs=None) unless user explicitly requests always-namespace or never-namespace. Treat docs/plate/ as the canonical location for PLATE scaffolding docs when namespacing is active. Update any agent prompts or skills that hard-code docs/ paths to check for both docs/ and docs/plate/ variants, or use should_namespace_docs() + namespace_docs_path() helpers from payload_surface. Direct existing installations to docs/migration/namespace-docs-migration.md for migration steps.
migration_guidance: 1. Review the comprehensive migration guide at docs/migration/namespace-docs-migration.md.
2. For automatic migration: run 'gh plate import-payload --namespace-docs --strategy force --apply' to re-import with namespace.
3. For manual migration: move PLATE subdirs with 'git mv docs/{adr,audits,bootstrap,design,marketing,migration,research,wiki} docs/plate/' and update references.
4. Update doc references in AGENTS.md, workflows, issue templates using search commands in migration guide.
5. Update wiki sync workflows to use docs/plate/wiki/ instead of docs/wiki/.
6. Verify migration using checklist in migration guide.
7. For edge cases (mixed trees, customized wikis, open PRs, CI workflows), see dedicated sections in migration guide.

entries.surface: AGENTS.md, .plate platform, import-payload, bootstrap, template validators
entries.migration_impact: Schema 1.3 adds optional top-level platform: posix, posix-and-windows, or windows. A missing key migrates to posix and means import-payload and bootstrap omit PLATE-owned .ps1 twins. posix-and-windows copies both flavors and validation requires both GIF scripts. windows omits PLATE-owned .sh twins, rewrites the copied template CI test job to pwsh -File scripts/ValidatePlateRepo.ps1 -Root . on windows-latest, and points the copied process-gifs job at gif-from-video.ps1 through pwsh. Existing destination files are not deleted. Adopter-owned scripts are outside the PLATE basename filter. PLATE itself sets posix-and-windows. --platform overrides .plate for that run and is persisted on apply. Invalid values fail closed. The operator OS is not consulted.
entries.agent_notes: Read .plate platform before authoring or copying scripts. Absent or JSON null means posix: author and copy .sh only. An empty string is invalid. posix-and-windows: .sh is primary and each operator-facing script also has a .ps1. windows: .ps1 only, copied template CI uses ValidatePlateRepo.ps1 on windows-latest, and the copied process-gifs job calls gif-from-video.ps1 through pwsh. Never infer platform from the laptop OS. --platform is an explicit human instruction and must be persisted on apply. When a remote .plate already exists, parse it before copying templates. A windows copy rewrites markdown commands that call omitted .sh helpers so they invoke the copied .ps1 files. Omit PLATE-owned twins from the copy set; do not delete files already in the destination and do not touch adopter-owned scripts. Invalid platform values fail closed.
migration_guidance: 1. Set .plate platform to posix (default when absent), posix-and-windows, or windows. Do not infer it from the operator machine, Windows dependencies, or CI host.

2. import-payload and bootstrap --apply copy PLATE-owned script twins for that value only. posix omits .ps1. windows omits .sh and rewrites package.json record:e2e to pwsh -File scripts/e2e-record.ps1. posix-and-windows copies both. Namespaced copies retarget PLATE script paths inside copied scripts and package.json to scripts/plate/. scripts/README.md and scripts/dev-server.js always copy. Pass --platform to override .plate; apply writes the value back. A remote .plate that is not valid JSON fails bootstrap instead of being read as posix. An empty or whitespace-only platform string is invalid in every reader, including an explicit --platform, and does not fall through to the stored value. JSON null loads as posix. When --platform is set and a remote .plate already exists, bootstrap parses that file before copying templates.

3. Validation follows the same value and accepts scripts/ or scripts/plate/. posix requires gif-from-video.sh. posix-and-windows requires both GIF scripts and template CI stays on the shell validator. windows requires gif-from-video.ps1, the copied CI job runs ValidatePlateRepo.ps1 on windows-latest, and the copied process-gifs job calls gif-from-video.ps1 through pwsh. The PowerShell validator rejects a non-string platform, including a one-element array, the same way the shell validator does. A platform value with an embedded newline or carriage return is invalid in the shell validator and is not normalized to posix.

4. Do not delete scripts with a *.ps1 or *.sh glob. The filter is basename-only for PLATE twins (validate_plate_repo.sh, ValidatePlateRepo.ps1, bootstrap_github.sh, BootstrapGitHub.ps1, check_toolchain.sh, CheckToolchain.ps1, question_batch.sh, QuestionBatch.ps1, e2e-record.sh, e2e-record.ps1, gif-from-video.sh, gif-from-video.ps1) at scripts/ or scripts/plate/.
5. Dual-stack repositories, including PLATE, set platform to posix-and-windows so both flavors stay. The template payload on disk remains the superset; the destination platform decides the copy.

entries.migration_impact: Additive routing. Agents completing adopt sessions should follow next_command (first-qa apply before feed when unseeded; not a re-plan loop).
